chars.K: KHADIJA: a young Moroccan woman schoolteacher wearing a long beige jellaba and a dark green hijab wrapped around her head.
chars.Y: YASSINE: a cheeky young Moroccan man wearing a red tracksuit with white side stripes, white sneakers and a small black backpack.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: On the flat rooftop of a Moroccan apartment building, a satellite dish lies knocked over and broken by the wind. KHADIJA stands with hands on hips looking at it in dismay while YASSINE peeks over the low rooftop wall with a cheeky grin, in open awkward tension. Dusty windy sky, other rooftops with dishes behind.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA walks home along a Moroccan street in the afternoon carrying a teacher's bag and a stack of notebooks, serious and tired, apartment buildings and small shops behind her.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the stairwell of the apartment building, YASSINE greets KHADIJA politely with a hand on his chest while she points up toward the roof and asks him a favor, slightly shy.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At the building entrance YASSINE jogs away waving goodbye with a confident thumbs up, while KHADIJA watches him go from the doorway.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside a cozy Moroccan living room with low sofas and cushions, KHADIJA has changed into a loose pink house pajama with a light scarf hanging on her shoulders, relaxing with a glass of mint tea, very comfortable.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA in her pink house pajama looks straight at the viewer with an embarrassed guilty face, one mitten hand covering her mouth, in the Moroccan living room.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA in her pink house pajama lies lazily on the Moroccan sofa scrolling her phone, totally relaxed, feet up, a switched-off TV in the background.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Split moment at an apartment door: KHADIJA in her pink house pajama jumps up in panic in the hallway grabbing a scarf, while on the other side of the door YASSINE in his red tracksuit knocks with a big smile. Comic shocked expression on her face.
